text:
Michael T: We need to schedule a post-incident review for RDW-503 (paging outage). IncidentBot shows resolved but we should lock facilitator + time. Prefer next Tue/Thu windows. @Incident Bot please drop the incident link and severity summary.
Incident Bot: INCIDENT RDW-503 resolved 2024-04-12T14:12Z. Severity: P1. Postmortem template: https://confluence.redwood.ai/template/pir. Timeline doc created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/RDW-503-timeline
Nisha P: Oncall handoff note: I paged infra at 13:44, escalated to DB at 13:58. Put full timeline in the doc. I'm +1 for Tue 16:00 UTC or Wed 10:00 PT.
Sara L: I can facilitate this PIR. Tue 16:00 UTC works for me. Will need primary owner to present mitigation timeline and what was live-fix vs manual.
Eva K: I can attend. Prefer Thu morning PT but can make Tue 16:00 UTC if we need a facilitator. I can take notes if Sara hosts.
Ops Lead: Please make sure product + support are invited so we can cover customer impact. product@redwood, support@redwood. Also propose we assign the failover automation follow-up now — it's high priority.
Michael T: Action item proposal: "Automate failover healthcheck" — owner? ETA 2w. @Sara L if you can facilitate, can you add that action as TBD owner and triage owners in the doc?
Sara L: Will add actions and ping owners. Tentative owner: infra/raj (I'll confirm). Created quick poll for times: https://cal.com/redwood/pir-1723456789 — please vote.
Eva K: I'll draft customer impact blurb for the doc and tag support for outreach. Will include list of affected customers and whether there was data loss or degraded performance.
Deploy Bot: Deployment note: last deploy to canary at 13:30 UTC. No config changes after. Quick logs command: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood-inference --since=2h`
Nisha P: Can we avoid times that are late for APAC? Proposed poll times: Tue 16:00 UTC, Wed 17:00 UTC, Thu 15:00 UTC. React with :thumbsup: for times that work.
Michael T: I'll tentatively schedule Tue 16:00 UTC pending votes. Meeting link (provisionally): https://zoom.us/j/123456789. Please add to calendar if you can.
Sara L: Added actions to the PIR doc: - Automate failover healthcheck (owner: TBD) - Post-incident alert tuning (owner: Eva K) - Runbook update for DB failover (owner: Raj M). I'll update owners by EOD and assign Jira tasks.
Eva K: Confirming I'll own post-incident alert tuning, ETA 1w. Adding more context to the doc now.
Ops Lead: Support, can you confirm who will own customer outreach for the three impacted accounts? Also please add a customer-impact label to the Jira ticket.
Michael T: Closing loop: postmortem draft assigned to Sara L. Draft deadline: 2024-04-19. We'll review during the meeting. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: Postmortem page created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pir/RDW-503. Calendar reminder scheduled for Tue 16:00 UTC.
